children: Renewal of Share Buyback Programme and Trading Update

The Board of AdvancedAdvT Limited (AIM: ADVT) (the "Company") today announces the launch of a further share buyback programme (the "New Buyback Programme") to purchase up to £10 million of the Company's ordinary shares of no par value ("Ordinary Shares"), following the successful completion of the initial programme announced on 4 March 2026.

The Board confirms that trading for the six months ended 31 August 2026 was in line with management expectations. The Company will provide a trading update for the first half in early October and will announce its interim results in the week of 2 November.

Under the initial buyback programme launched on 4 March 2026, the Company acquired 6,148,953 Ordinary Shares at a weighted average price of 162.63 pence per share, for total consideration of £10.0 million. The shares acquired are held in treasury.

The Board continues to believe that the current market price of the Ordinary Shares does not fully reflect the intrinsic value of the Group's software operations, and that a further buyback programme represents an attractive use of the Company's capital at current price levels.

The Company has re-appointed Singer Capital Markets Securities Limited ("Singer Capital Markets") to execute and manage the New Buyback Programme and has given an irrevocable instruction for Singer Capital Markets to undertake market purchases on its behalf for a period of 12 months from the date of this announcement. All trading decisions will be taken independently of the Company.

The New Buyback Programme permits the purchase of up to £10 million of Ordinary Shares, with the maximum price payable being no more than 5 per cent. above the average middle market quotation for the five business days immediately preceding the date of any repurchase. The Directors have confirmed that neither they nor persons connected with them intend to sell Ordinary Shares to the Company during the programme. There is no guarantee that the New Buyback Programme will be implemented in full or that any purchases will be made.

Any Ordinary Shares acquired under the New Buyback Programme may be held in treasury and used to satisfy future obligations under the Group's employee share schemes or as consideration for future acquisitions, providing the Group with additional flexibility in the execution of its strategy. Alternatively, they may be cancelled.

The Board continues to consider a further substantial return of capital to shareholders, as set out in the announcement of 4 March 2026. The New Buyback Programme announced today reflects the Board's assessment that on-market share purchases at current price levels represent an attractive use of capital in the near term and does not preclude further returns of capital in due course. The Board will update shareholders as and when appropriate.

The Board remains focused on disciplined capital allocation. The Group continues to see an attractive and active pipeline of bolt-on acquisition opportunities and expects to continue deploying capital into value-accretive transactions. As an AIM-quoted company, the Group also retains the ability to access the equity capital markets should a larger opportunity arise.
Singer Capital Markets (Nominated Adviser and Broker)
AdvancedAdvT Limited (AdvT) provides software solutions and platforms across two business transformational areas: business solutions & healthcare compliance, and human capital management.

AdvT is an agent for change. The Group enables the delivery of Artificial Intelligence ("AI"), data analytics and business intelligence, all of which are key future drivers for growth in those sectors where long term digitisation trends are set to transform the workplace for professionals.
AdvT is developing both organically and through acquisitions, by expanding its presence across adjacent markets, geographical boundaries and digital sectors.
